summary.status: auth and runtime crash resolved; remaining failures are frontend route/UX drift

resolved_issues.description: Frontend no longer crashes with 'useAuth can only be used within the <ClerkProvider /> component' when VITE_AUTH_PROVIDER=legacy. AuthContext, ClerkAuthBridge, RootRedirect, RequireClerkAuth, RequireOrganization, AppHeader, useTenantMembership, ClerkSignIn, ClerkSignUp, SelectOrganization, and Onboarding now short-circuit or conditionally invoke Clerk hooks in legacy mode.
case-meridian-e2e-001 is now seeded via the Layer 4 validation endpoint approved_case_aliases. Seeder output confirms business-case records present.

Backend-integrated auth fixture now calls the Layer 4 /v1/validation/session endpoint directly, parses the Set-Cookie header, and injects vf_session/vf_csrf_token cookies into the Playwright browser context so legacy-mode API requests are authenticated.
docker-compose.live.yml frontend service now explicitly sets VITE_AUTH_PROVIDER=legacy and VITE_ENABLE_MOCK_AUTH=true, aligning the live validation stack with docker-compose.dev.yml.

remaining_blockers.description: J1 tests navigate to legacy non-tenant-scoped routes (e.g., /settings/data/value-packs) that no longer exist in the current tenant-scoped router. The canonical route is /t/:tenantSlug/settings/value-packs. These are test-debt failures, not runtime auth blockers.
Some J1 routes (e.g., /value-case/:accountId) have no matching page component in the current frontend, yielding 404.

sample_error: GP-BI-002: navigating to /settings/data/value-packs renders 404 because the router expects /t/:tenantSlug/settings/value-packs.
recommendation: Either align J1 test routes/selectors with the current tenant-scoped UI and page components, or run P0 journeys in a Clerk-configured staging environment. The runtime auth path is now stable and the candidate is re-testable.
